mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sacs to the capillaries was the most worthwhile: the planned comparison shows each gas moving down its own partial-pressure difference, clarifying their opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The attempted direct connection of bronchioles to the exchange surface was least worthwhile: it failed without explaining why the airway tree needed to be built first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the small bronchioles could not attach directly to the supported exchange surface, despite facing the gas-exchanging region in their description.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary: the visible descriptions suggested a direct connection, but the large and small conducting airways had to be combined first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions linked physical structures to functions, especially gas diffusion and airway resistance. The term partial pressure could still use a brief explanation for students encountering it for the first time.
